cases.scenario: ambiguous reused request -> MC questions + v1
cases.prompt: Write me a prompt I can reuse every month to turn my consulting clients' numbers into a monthly report for them.
assertions: [O] each question is multiple choice with 2-4 listed options
[O] each question marks a recommended option or lists it first as the default
[O] offers an option or clear invitation to add more context in the user's own words
[O] delivers a usable first-draft prompt in the same reply (not questions only)
[O] the reply ends with a JAIL-HANDOFF block

cases.scenario: new context after earlier rounds -> another round allowed, draft updated
cases.prompt: Continuing from before: you already asked me two rounds of questions about the monthly client report prompt and I answered them (owners, one page, plain English). New context: two of these clients are banks, so anything about customer accounts is regulated and must never appear by name in the report. Update the prompt.
assertions: [O] delivers an updated prompt that adds a rule keeping customer/account names or identifiers out of the report
[O] does not refuse or skip further questions because of how many rounds already happened (either asks a short new round about the bank context or states its assumptions)
[O] any questions asked are multiple choice with an option to add more context
[O] keeps the earlier answers (owners, one page, plain English) in the updated prompt

cases.prompt: Give me a quick prompt to turn my bullet notes from a client call into a 3-sentence follow-up email. Just for today.
assertions: [O] asks no clarifying questions (or only optional ones after the prompt)
[O] gives the prompt as a copyable block
[O] includes a TEST RESULTS or UNTESTED line
